subject.title: fix(searxng): fail closed on unresolved base url refs

question: Should an explicitly configured but unavailable SearXNG `baseUrl` continue to fall back to `SEARXNG_BASE_URL`, or should it become a hard runtime error for existing installations?
rationale: Current source and documentation expose ambient fallback as part of the resolution order, while this PR intentionally replaces that working path with an error; tests cannot determine which compatibility contract maintainers want.

options.title: Preserve existing fallback
options.body: Keep ambient `SEARXNG_BASE_URL` as the compatibility behavior until a separately approved migration or policy change is defined.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed behavior
options.body: Approve the explicit configuration boundary, require upgrade wording and fresh current-head loopback proof, then merge the focused change.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing fallback
recommendation.body: Keep ambient `SEARXNG_BASE_URL` as the compatibility behavior until a separately approved migration or policy change is defined.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is connected to the canonical SearXNG feature-routing history and is the strongest available owner signal for the provider contract.
